nut_mode.description: Operational mode for NUT. Typically 'standalone' (single UPS, local only), 'netserver' (serve UPS data over network), or 'netclient' (connect to remote NUT server).

ups_list.description: List of UPS devices to configure and monitor.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the UPS.

serial.description: UPS serial number (optional, used for device matching).

poll_interval.description: Polling interval in seconds (default 2, reduce for unstable connections).

pollonly.description: If true, only poll UPS data (do not issue shutdown commands).

master.description: If true, this UPS is a master — it may trigger shutdowns of connected clients.

allowed_hosts.description: List of trusted hosts allowed to connect to upsd. Each entry defines a name, IP, and allowed actions.

users.description: User accounts for authenticating with upsd. Each user has a name, optional password, and access rights.

users[].password.description: User's password (if not set, comment the line).

users[].disabled.description: If true, comment out the user line (for temporary deactivation).

listen_ip.description: IP address to bind the upsd listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '::', '0.0.0.0').

listen_port.description: TCP port for upsd to listen on (default 3493).

enable_upsd_tcp.description: If true, enable TCP/IP protocol support (required for netclient/netserver mode).

enable_upsd_usb.description: If true, enable USB HID protocol support (required for direct-USB UPS).
